note: The Vlasov equation was proposed by Anatoly Vlasov in 1938, but the global regularity problem for solutions of the Vlasov-Maxwell system emerged from rigorous mathematical study in the 1980s, particularly following Glassey and Strauss's 1986 work showing conditional regularity results. No single date marks the formal posing of this as an open problem; it appears to have arisen naturally as researchers studied the system. The global existence of classical solutions remains an open problem.
